blocks.text: Source aur observer (sunne wale) ki relative motion (ek doosre ke muqable mein harkat) ki wajah se waves ki frequency (ya pitch) mein jo apparent (zahiri) tabdeeli mehsoos hoti hai, use Doppler Effect kehte hain.

Yeh effect sab se pehle Doppler ne sitaron se aane wali light (roshni) ki frequency dekhte hue note kiya. Kuch sitaron ki light ki frequency Zameen par usi qism ke source ki light se thori different (alag alag) thi. Us ne dekha ke light ki frequency ki tabdeeli sitare ki Zameen ke relative motion par depend karti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab naam “John Doppler” likhti hai. Sahi naam Christian Doppler (Christian Andreas Doppler, 1803–1853) hai, jo Austria ke physicist the.

Yeh effect sound waves mein bhi nazar aata hai. Misal: railway platform par khare shakhs ko platform ki taraf aate engine ki seeti ki pitch oonchi lagti hai, aur platform se door jate engine ki seeti ki pitch neechi lagti hai.

Maan lein sound ka source S aaram (rest) mein hai aur wavelength λ ki sound waves nikalta hai. Thehre hue observer ke liye sound ki speed v ho, to observer ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki number (tadaad), yani frequency f, yeh hai:
